message.content: On July 7, 2026, at 16:00, LiHua expresses concern about potential issues in the basement after recent rainstorms. She specifically mentions that she wants to ensure everything is okay down there and that she will keep an eye on it. Adam assures her that everything seems fine after the storms and advises her to continue monitoring for any unusual occurrences. He also offers to provide the contact details for the maintenance worker in case LiHua notices anything concerning. This indicates that LiHua and Adam are worried about potential water damage or structural issues in the basement due to the recent rainfall, and they are taking proactive measures to address any potential problems.
